title_en: I Will Come to You at Night
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear: no author I can name. Translated fully; 'to the pillow' in line 2 is my reading of 'на перница'.

words_to_learn.en: evil hour (late, dangerous time of night)

lines.cyr: Ќе ти дојдам вечер јас во зла доба,
lines.lat: Ḱe ti dojdam večer jas vo zla doba,
lines.en: I will come to you in the evening, at the evil hour,

lines.cyr: ќе ти легнам тивко јас на перница.
lines.lat: ḱe ti legnam tivko jas na pernica.
lines.en: I will lie down quietly beside you on the pillow.

lines.cyr: Ќе ти дојдам вечер, пенџер отвори,
lines.lat: Ḱe ti dojdam večer, pendžer otvori,
lines.en: I will come to you in the evening, open the window,

lines.cyr: љубов што ти носам ќе нè изгори.
lines.lat: ljubov što ti nosam ḱe nè izgori.
lines.en: the love I bring you will burn us both.

lines.cyr: Кај ли беше, кој те видел,
lines.lat: Kaj li beše, koj te videl,
lines.en: Where were you, who saw you,

lines.cyr: љубов ти си криела.
lines.lat: ljubov ti si kriela.
lines.en: you were hiding love.

lines.cyr: Ладна постела ти била,
lines.lat: Ladna postela ti bila,
lines.en: Your bed was cold,

lines.cyr: сама ти си спиела.
lines.lat: sama ti si spiela.
lines.en: you slept alone.

lines.cyr: Зошто од мене се криеш,
lines.lat: Zošto od mene se krieš,
lines.en: Why do you hide from me,

lines.cyr: љубов ти побарај ми.
lines.lat: ljubov ti pobaraj mi.
lines.en: seek out love for me.

lines.cyr: Немој мене да ме лажеш,
lines.lat: Nemoj mene da me lažeš,
lines.en: Do not lie to me,

lines.cyr: што те мачи кажи ми.
lines.lat: što te mači kaži mi.
lines.en: tell me what torments you.

lines.cyr: Зумбул цвеќе ќе ми бидеш,
lines.lat: Zumbul cveḱe ḱe mi bideš,
lines.en: You will be my hyacinth flower,

lines.cyr: ќе ми красиш дворови.
lines.lat: ḱe mi krasiš dvorovi.
lines.en: you will adorn my courtyards.

lines.cyr: Јас на други не те давам,
lines.lat: Jas na drugi ne te davam,
lines.en: I will not give you to anyone else,

lines.cyr: ќе те љубам до зори.
lines.lat: ḱe te ljubam do zori.
lines.en: I will love you until dawn.
